title: Local triviality of a descended invertible module
statement: Let \(f:X\to S\) be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], whose tensor-pullback structure-module adjunction unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] is an isomorphism after every base change [def-pc-base-change]. Let \(M\) be invertible on \(X\) [def-sc-invertible-module], \(k:W\to S\) any morphism, and \(w\in W\). Assume there is a finite locally free module \(N\) on \(W\) [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] and an isomorphism \(M_W\cong f_W^*N\), with tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. There exists an open neighbourhood \(V\) of \(w\) such that for every open \(U\subseteq V\), the pullback of \(M\) to \(X\times_S U\) is isomorphic to its structure module. No properness, flatness, source direct image, derived complex, or family of target schemes is asserted.

proof.text: Test the universal unit at Spec kappa(w) mapping to S through k. If the fibre is empty, every module on it is zero, and pushforward has zero sections. An isomorphism from the nonzero residue-field structure module to that pushforward is impossible. Thus this fibre has a point.

Choose a finite free frame of N near w. Pull it to a point of the nonempty residue fibre. Tensor-pullback composition and the descent isomorphism identify its pullback with an invertible module. On Spec kappa(w), the field rank-one theorem trivializes the pullback of N; comparison of its finite free frame with this rank-one module forces its number of generators to be one. Therefore the frame of N near w has rank one.

For any U inside this frame neighbourhood, restrict the frame and pull it back along f_U. Compose with the base change of the descent isomorphism. The cartesian projection identities and composition of pullback identify the resulting bundle with M_U. Pullback of the structure module is the structure module, so M_U is trivial.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_descendedInvertible_neighbourhood
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) (w : W)
    (hM : ∃ (N : W.Modules) (_ : N.IsFiniteLocallyFree),
      Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj M ≅
        (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f k)).obj N)) :
    ∃ V : W.Opens, w ∈ V ∧ ∀ U : W.Opens, U ≤ V →
      Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (U.ι ≫ k))).obj M ≅
        SheafOfModules.unit (pullback f (U.ι ≫ k)).ringCatSheaf)
